findings.motion: SB 1174 Min Senate Third Reading By BERMAN (Assembly Floor, passed 57 to 16)
findings.note: Voted aye on the Assembly floor for SB 1174, which bars cities and charter cities from requiring ID to vote or submit a ballot at a polling place or vote center. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.

findings.motion: AB 1116 Berman Assembly Third Reading (Assembly Floor, passed 60 to 18)
findings.note: Voted aye on the Assembly floor for AB 1116, which lets a person without a state driver's license or ID card register online by giving the last four digits of their Social Security number and a digital signature image. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page.
